summary: Piscataquis Co., ME: a 40-ft tower put up in 1924 in Township 5 Range 10; removed 2004-05; a Baxter State Park trail now reaches the concrete footings.

facts.status_note: Removed between 2004 and 2005; a hiking guide says only the concrete footings of the tower remain at the summit
facts.agency: State forestry department in 1924 (Maine Forestry District per Forest Lookouts); site now inside Baxter State Park

access.note: A hiking guide describes a trail to the summit inside Baxter State Park; no closure or permit is mentioned

visit.trail_note: 1.3 miles one way to the summit; trailhead about 13.7 miles down the Park Tote Road from the Matagamon Gate

events.note: Steel bought in April 1924 for lookout stations including a 40-foot tower on Burnt Mountain; crew had put it up by July 1924 (Daily Kennebec Journal items quoted on Forest Lookouts)

Removed between 2004 and 2005 per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register (the year shown is the earlier bound)

notes_for_editor: The 1924 build rests on two Daily Kennebec Journal items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, consistent with the 1925 state map. The brief's access 'unknown' is filled with 'public' only as an inference from a hiking guide that describes a trail in the park; check before publishing. The brief's agency (Baxter State Park) is right for today; the 1924 operator was the state forestry department. A search summary cited a Maine database entry giving 1,792 ft and an installed-1924 date; the database URLs returned 404 so those figures are not used, and the hiking guide gives 1,796 ft. No staffing, fire or caretaker history appears in any source read. The register's 2004-2005 removal range is shown as year 2004 in events.
